_comment: Fight performance budgets (tech-artist 2026-11-27, Boss: 'the fps drops' keeps coming back). Checked by tests/test_perf_budget.gd (headless: VFX bundle draws, settings) and by the windowed gate client/perf/fight_bench.tscn -- --gate (boss wave of each zone, frozen frame, desktop and phone profiles; run before a web deploy: tools/perf/perf_gate.ps1). draw_calls/primitives are Godot's per-frame counters in the gl_compatibility renderer at 1920x987 (desktop) and 932x430 (phone). New content must fit: a new monster, VFX or prop that breaks a row is a bug, not a new budget.
_baseline_2026_11_27: measured native RTX 3070 Ti, gate frozen boss frame (live VFX keep playing, so +-20% between runs): goblin 287/289k desktop, 327/283k phone; mummy 266/188k, 410/152k; orc 195/169k, 202/150k. Budgets = measured + headroom; tighten as content is slimmed.
_phone_2026_11_27: Boss phone Lag Report 11:35 (build 38706f4d077e, 4 cores, DPR 3, canvas 2796x1290, style on chosen but slow-device verdict = no screen pass/no hero hulls, orc boss wave): 19-24 fps, draw 170-225 ms/s, one ~200 ms 'draw' frame per second. Native at the phone canvas size: 2796x1290 6.4 ms vs 1864x860 3.7 ms (x1.7 draw+UI). Fix: play.html caps devicePixelRatio at phone_canvas_max_dpr (0.44x pixels). Hero ink hulls: no boots/gloves hull when the screen pass runs, 400-tri floor on every device: goblin desktop hero hulls 71 -> 38, +48k -> +38k primitives. Gate 2026-11-27 after: goblin 301/289k, 312/277k; mummy 248/173k, 266/141k; orc 210/177k, 195-281/143-145k (orc phone dc is VFX noise between runs).
